Command eight vehicles against six opponents.
Use buildings to break the enemy line of sight.
Eliminate all hostile vehicles to win.

entries.en:
Low: 75% rendering, 30 FPS cap, no shadows.
Medium: 100% rendering, 60 FPS cap, shadows.
High: medium settings plus 4× MSAA.
Frame rate caps are targets, not guarantees.
